name: Hayakita Itsuki
source: Itsuki goes to the island with no idea what awaits him other than it's a place to foster relations between boys and girls. He likes to dress as a girl which his sister knows but very few others. When [url=https://vndb.org/c23742]Rio[/url] finds out she makes an exception for him to wear clothes and forces him to wear a dress for several days. This simply increases his popularity with the girls.
